manuscript_claim: BC <= 5/9 is a distribution-free threshold that rejects all unimodal noise
code_implementation: Computes Sarle's BC with finite-sample kurtosis correction; checks bc >= 5/9 in null_calibrated mode
audit_finding: False for asymmetric unimodal distributions (Beta(3,1) BC=0.562, Exp BC=0.556) and zero-inflated continuous noise. Holds strictly only for symmetric continuous unimodal densities.

manuscript_claim: Critical separation bound for 2-component symmetric Gaussian mixtures is Delta / sigma_0 >= 1.854
code_implementation: Used to justify 5/9 threshold for cluster feature gating
audit_finding: Mathematically proven as analytical root of 2*theta^2 - 6*theta - 3 = 0. However, mixtures with Delta in (1.0, 1.854) are bimodal in density but yield BC < 5/9, so BGSS rejects moderately separated clusters.

manuscript_claim: BGSS reliably detects informative cluster features in high dimensions
code_implementation: Univariate marginal screening using Sarle's BC
audit_finding: Fundamentally blind to non-marginal signals (XOR/parity BC=0.33, diagonal covariances BC=0.33, concentric circles BC=0.40, oblique mixtures with negative covariance DM=7.16sigma yet BC=0.35). High-dimensional noise fluctuations displace interaction features.

manuscript_claim: Default BGSS applies null-calibrated 5/9 threshold
code_implementation: Default pool_mode is 'legacy', which never checks 5/9; extracts top 15% features unconditionally
audit_finding: Code contradicts theory document. In legacy mode, for D <= 100, top_frac = 1.0 and zero feature screening occurs. In null_calibrated mode, fallback unconditionally selects max(2, K) features if < 2 pass.

manuscript_claim: Finite-sample Sarle's BC reliably identifies two-point cluster separation
code_implementation: Finite-sample kurtosis correction c_N = (N-1)^2 / ((N-2)(N-3))
audit_finding: For perfect two-point symmetric data, BC = (N-2)(N-3)/(N^2-1). For N <= 9, BC < 5/9, failing to detect even 100% separated clusters at small sample sizes (N=4 BC=0.133, N=6 BC=0.343).

manuscript_claim: Exact linear-memory determinacy identity sigma_i = 1/(N-1) sum_{j != i} S_ij^2
code_implementation: Vectorized radix-K bincount contingency accumulation: counts[joint] across M^2 model pairs
audit_finding: Mathematically proven exact. Numerical error ||Delta||_inf <= 2.78e-17. More accurate and stable than dense matrix multiplication. Executes in < 0.08 s for N=50,000.

manuscript_claim: Proposition 2 proves equivalence between ICC-v2 anchor consensus and dense consensus clustering
code_implementation: Anchor bipartite Transfer-Cut Laplacian L_norm in R^(LxL) vs dense Laplacian L_S in R^(NxN)
audit_finding: Proposition 2 computes the scalar determinacy statistic sigma_i exactly, NOT spectral clustering equivalence. Subspaces have non-zero principal angles (up to 38 deg). Anchor clustering is an approximation that filters noise edges.

manuscript_claim: Reduced bipartite anchor affinity matrix W_A = B_norm^T B_norm is equivalent to Transfer-Cut
code_implementation: Computes W_A = B_norm^T B_norm = B^T D_X^(-2) B
audit_finding: Diverges from theoretical Transfer-Cut W_r = B^T D_X^(-1) B by an extra factor of D_X^(-1). Introduces quadratic imbalance distortion, weighting instances in small clusters up to 81x higher than large clusters.

manuscript_claim: Transfer-Cut spectral embedding U_emb = B_norm @ D_A^(-1/2) @ V_core / sqrt(1 - lambda) is numerically stable
code_implementation: Scales columns by 1/sqrt(sig) where sig = max(1 - lambda, 1e-9)
audit_finding: When eigenvalues lambda_j >= 1.0 (common in real/noisy graphs), 1 - lambda <= 0 is clipped to 1e-9, causing a 31,622x singular blow-up that crushes all other dimensions upon row-normalization into a 1D scalar coordinate. Legacy mode omits scaling and is more stable.

manuscript_claim: Uniform random anchor selection reliably spans all K clusters
code_implementation: L = min(n_anchors, len(core_idx)) drawn uniformly without replacement
audit_finding: Feasibility strictly requires L >= K. By Coupon Collector's Theorem, L=K has up to 99.96% failure rate of covering all K clusters. For imbalanced clusters, covering a minority cluster pi_min requires L >= ln(1/delta)/pi_min (e.g. L >= 100 for pi_min=0.03).

manuscript_claim: Instances unrepresented by anchors receive valid spectral embeddings
code_implementation: Row sums < 1e-12 clamped to 1.0; zero rows remain 0; norm clamped to 1.0
audit_finding: Unanchored instances collapse to the identical origin vector 0 in R^K. If >= 2 clusters lack anchors, they merge at 0, destroying cluster geometry and triggering K-means convergence failures.

manuscript_claim: Certified core anchors provide significant clustering accuracy lift over uniform random anchors
code_implementation: Anchors sampled from top core_quantile stability instances
audit_finding: Empirical factorial ablation (Knockout 4) proves a null result: Delta = +0.019, 95% CI [-0.039, +0.082], p = 0.84. Core certification provides no statistically significant lift over uniform random anchors.

manuscript_claim: Stability-weighted centroids c_k = sum sigma_i x_i / sum sigma_i provide robust geometry-calibrated centroids
code_implementation: Weighted average of training instances using sample_stability
audit_finding: Degenerates to unweighted mean under high consensus agreement (sigma_i = const within cluster). When N > 2000, stability definition silently switches from Proposition 2 determinacy to mean anchor similarity (r=0.67 correlation).

manuscript_claim: Theorem 1 bounds out-of-sample inductive misclassification probability by (K-1) exp(-Delta_min^2 / (8 sigma_max^2))
code_implementation: Proves nearest-centroid misclassification bound under sub-Gaussian noise
audit_finding: Holds only for known population centroids with isotropic spherical noise and zero noise dimensions. Collapses on non-linear manifolds (Delta_min=0), anisotropic clusters (error 38.5%), and high dimensions D >> N where centroid error scales as O(sqrt(D/N)).

manuscript_claim: Inductive predict() preserves the non-linear cluster geometry discovered by spectral consensus
code_implementation: Linear Euclidean nearest centroid assignment in ambient feature space R^D
audit_finding: Fundamental geometric disconnect. Transductive clustering operates on non-linear manifold cuts in R^K, but predict() imposes flat Euclidean Voronoi hyperplanes in R^D. Collapses on concentric circles (train ARI 1.0 vs predict ARI -0.005) and causes in-sample self-inconsistency.

manuscript_claim: ICC-v2 total training time complexity is strictly linear in N: O(N(D + M d_sub K + M^2 + M L) + L^3)
code_implementation: Evaluates screening, base models, determinacy identity, bipartite graph, and reduced Laplacian
audit_finding: Mathematically proven. All operations scaling with N have linear coefficients; cubic term L^3 depends strictly on the anchor budget L << N.

manuscript_claim: ICC-v2 auxiliary consensus space complexity is O(N L)
code_implementation: Bipartite graph matrix B replacing N x N co-association matrix S
audit_finding: Holds for the bipartite graph storage B in R^(N x L). However, total auxiliary memory includes ensemble partition stack P_stack in R^(M x N), so total auxiliary memory is O(N(M + L + K) + L^2).

manuscript_claim: ICC-v2 clusters N = 10^6 instances with 240 MB graph memory, bypassing the 8 TB dense barrier
code_implementation: B in R^(10^6 x 30) float64 = 240 MB vs S in R^(10^6 x 10^6) float64 = 8 TB
audit_finding: Mathematically exact. 10^6 * 30 * 8 bytes = 240 MB. Total auxiliary memory including partition stack (uint8) is ~345 MB, easily fitting in workstation RAM.

manuscript_claim: CICC split-conformal prediction sets satisfy finite-sample coverage guarantee Pr(y_true in C(x)) >= 1 - alpha
code_implementation: Calibrates on model's own nearest-centroid pseudo-labels: cal_labels = argmax(cos_cal, axis=1)
audit_finding: Guarantee applies strictly to model pseudo-labels Y_pseudo, NOT true biological labels Y_true. On real patient biopsies (Leukemia), empirical coverage collapses to 46.7% despite nominal 90% claim.

manuscript_claim: CICC conformal guarantee with respect to pseudo-labels provides an in-distribution abstention bound
code_implementation: Prediction set C(x) includes argmax pseudo-label iff C(x) is non-empty
audit_finding: Mathematically proven. Since Y_pseudo in C(x) <=> |C(x)| >= 1, the conformal guarantee Pr(Y_pseudo in C(x)) >= 1 - alpha is mathematically identical to Pr(C(x) = empty) <= alpha + 1/(N_cal + 1).

manuscript_claim: Conformal prediction nonconformity score matches theoretical Euclidean formulation in theory.md
code_implementation: Code implements temperature-scaled cosine softmax complement: s_i = 1 - p_y(x) across all D features
audit_finding: Discrepancy. Theory specifies Euclidean distance s_i = ||x[F_gate] - c_y[F_gate]||_2 on gated features, while code uses softmax probabilities on full D dimensions without feature slicing.

manuscript_claim: Softmax conformal nonconformity score allows outlier detection via empty prediction sets C(x) = empty
code_implementation: Checks is_abstention = (len(C(x)) == 0) to route novel samples to incremental memory
audit_finding: If q_hat >= 1 - 1/K, max_k p_k(x) >= 1/K implies C(x) is non-empty for all possible inputs in R^D, making abstention mathematically impossible. Equidistant outliers receive full set {0, ..., K-1}.

manuscript_claim: Small-calibration split-conformal quantile achieves 1 - alpha coverage
code_implementation: q_level = min(1.0, ceil((N_cal + 1)(1 - alpha)) / N_cal); q_hat = quantile(cal_scores, q_level)
audit_finding: When N_cal < 1/alpha - 1, ceil((N_cal+1)(1-alpha)) > N_cal, so q_level > 1.0. Clamping to 1.0 takes sample max, which has true coverage of only N_cal/(N_cal+1) < 1 - alpha (e.g. 83.3% at N_cal=5, alpha=0.10).

manuscript_claim: ConformalClusterer is invariant to input normalization
code_implementation: fit_calibrate leaves X_cal unnormalized, while predict unit-normalizes X_test
audit_finding: Normalization asymmetry bug. Standalone use with unnormalized features causes empirical coverage to drop from 90% to 67% (-23% undercoverage).

manuscript_claim: ConformalClusterer supports non-contiguous or 1-based cluster labels
code_implementation: c_true = int(labels_cal[i]); cal_scores[i] = 1.0 - probs_cal[i, c_true]
audit_finding: Crashes with IndexError: index 3 is out of bounds for axis 1 with size 3 when cluster labels are 1-based {1, 2, 3}. Evaluates true in prediction_sets against positional indices, corrupting coverage.

manuscript_claim: Target-decoy feature gating controls False Discovery Rate (FDR) below target level
code_implementation: Mirror statistics W_j = |T_j| - |T_tilde_j| from permuted or Gaussian decoys
audit_finding: Theoretical exchangeability violated: cluster labels derived from X create post-clustering selection bias (60.9% null positives); permutation destroys feature covariance; fallback bug selects top noise feature with 100% FDR.

manuscript_claim: Decoy feature gating active subset is applied during inductive CICC consensus inference
code_implementation: self.selected_features_ is computed by DecoyFeatureGating in fit()
audit_finding: Dead code in consensus pipeline. self.selected_features_ is computed but never passed to centroids, X_cal, ConformalClusterer, or predict_conformal. All operations execute on full ambient dimension D.

manuscript_claim: Point-of-Care Patient Biopsy Projection achieves 90% conformal validity
code_implementation: InductiveConsensusClusterer evaluated on prospective Leukemia patient biopsies
audit_finding: Empirically refuted by repository's own benchmark demo, which outputs: 'Empirical Out-of-Sample Coverage: 46.7%' on Leukemia biopsies, with 33.3% abstentions and 20% toxic misclassifications.

manuscript_claim: ICC-AutoK PAC metric reliably determines optimal cluster number K
code_implementation: Senbabaoglu PAC metric on anchor co-association matrix BB^T
audit_finding: Applies PAC to L1-normalized bipartite matrix where inner products cannot exceed 1/L_c <= 0.091 < 0.10. Ambiguity interval (0.10, 0.90) is identically empty, forcing PAC=0 and 100% collapse to K_min in 510/510 trials.

manuscript_claim: Large-N execution branch in icc.py maintains theoretical determinacy consistency
code_implementation: dense_threshold fallback switches from Proposition 2 to 1000-point dense subsampling and mean(B, axis=1)
audit_finding: Bypasses Proposition 2 for N > 2000, allocates 1000x1000 dense matrix (25 MB), and replaces determinacy stability with mean anchor affinity (r=0.67 correlation), creating inconsistent centroid weighting across sample sizes.
